items.heading: If You Are Looking
items.text: If you are looking for certificate courses for BCom students, do not start with a list of "top 10". Start with a question: who will vouch for this certificate if a recruiter phones them? NISM will vouch for its own exam.

items.heading: The 4
items.text: The 4-Rung Certificate Ladder is a simple way to judge any certificate before you pay. Higher rung means more weight with an employer and usually a lower fee. Use it every time.

items.heading: Nism , the National Institute
items.text: NISM , the National Institute of Securities Markets, runs certification exams for the securities industry. The exams are online and remote-proctored, and the certificates stay valid for 3 years from the exam date.

items.heading: 1 Year 1
items.text: 1 Year 1: Learn free, spend nothing Ask your department which SWAYAM courses it accepts for credit. Finish one. Take the free SEBI Investor Awareness Test. Learn spreadsheet basics from free sources. The aim is to find which of the three areas (accounts, markets, analysis) you can sit with for hours without boredom.

items.heading: 2 Year 2
items.text: 2 Year 2: Pick one lane and pay for one certificate Choose the lane from Year 1. Accounts and tax: a TallyPrime course from a Tally Authorised Learning Centre, or the Tally Bookkeeper certificate on Coursera. Markets: study for one NISM exam and book it late in Year 2 or in Year 3, so its 3-year validity covers your job search. Analysis: a Power BI or Excel course with a project. Keep the total near the budget guide in the cost table above.

items.heading: 3 Year 3
items.text: 3 Year 3: Turn the certificate into proof Build one piece of work you can show: a year of entries in TallyPrime for a small family shop, a one-page market note, or a sales dashboard from a public dataset. Then apply for internships with the work attached, not only the certificate. If you also want CA, CMA, or CS, this is the year to plan that separately.

figures.label: Students Higher Education
figures.source: The Ministry of Education's AISHE 2021-22 survey counts about 4.33 crore students in higher education, 78.9% of them undergraduates, and puts commerce at 13.3% of undergraduates. That is roughly 45 lakh commerce undergraduates at one time. A certificate a recruiter can check in one click sets you apart from that pool; one they cannot check does not.
